candidates.source_name: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (UBCG) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: The national banking association is the single most important non-state actor in Montenegrin banking regulation: it consolidates member-bank positions on draft laws (e.g. it submitted comments on the Draft Law on Bank Resolution and on AML/CFT amendments), runs 16 professional committees mapped to regulatory topics (payment systems, compliance, AML, digitalisation/fintech, ALM/liquidity, legal, accounting), and is an affiliate of the European Banking Federation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of /blog/, /publikacije/, /propisi/ and wp-content/uploads PDF paths; diff new PDFs and news items.
queries_used: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore članice

candidates.source_name: UBCG — member bank list ("O nama")
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative, cheap enumeration of the full population of licensed banks in Montenegro (11 members observed: Addiko, Adriatic, CKB, Erste, Hipotekarna, Lovćen, NLB, Prva banka, Universal Capital, Zapad, Ziraat) — the seed list for per-bank source scouting. Also enumerates the 16 committees, which is a map of which regulatory topics the sector organises around.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off HTML scrape to seed an actor registry; re-check quarterly for membership changes (entries/exits signal licence changes).
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of association About page
queries_used: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore članice

candidates.source_name: UBCG — Statut, Program rada and Pregled rada (annual work programme / activity report)
candidates.why_relevant: The annual work programme and activity review state, in the association's own words, which draft laws and regulatory files it intends to engage on in the coming year and which it responded to in the previous one — an early-warning calendar for regulatory workstreams and consultation deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull + text extraction; watch /wp-content/uploads/<year>/ for new filenames matching Program-rada / Pregled-rada / STATUT.
candidates.discovered_via_method: link harvest from UBCG About page
queries_used: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore članice

candidates.source_name: UBCG — "Bankar" magazine (association journal)
candidates.why_relevant: Long-running association periodical (issues into the 70s as of 2026) carrying articles by bank and regulator staff on regulatory change, supervision practice and payments; a rich narrative source on how the sector reads incoming rules, and a named-person directory for the industry.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate issue PDFs under wp-content/uploads; OCR/text-extract and index by regulation keywords.
queries_used: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore članice

candidates.source_name: UBCG — Propisi (curated banking legislation page)
candidates.why_relevant: A sector-curated shortlist of the laws the banks themselves consider core (Zakon o CBCG, Zakon o bankama, Zakon o stečaju i likvidaciji banaka, ZSPNFT, Zakon o platnom prometu, Zakon o zaštiti depozita, Zakon o zaštiti potrošača) plus outbound links to CBCG, Government, securities regulator, court registry and the AML authority — a compact pointer set for the A3 regulatory perimeter.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest outbound links once to seed the institutional source list; re-check semi-annually for newly added laws.
candidates.discovered_via_method: site navigation from UBCG About page

candidates.source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore (Chamber of Economy of Montenegro)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory chamber is an institutional partner of the Government and a standing channel for business comments on draft legislation; it hosts sector Association Boards (odbori udruženja) including one covering banking, other financial organisations and insurance, and runs a business-barrier reporting tool that surfaces regulatory friction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the news/announcements stream and the association-board pages; site uses parallel /pkcg/ (sr) and /en/cem/ (en) paths — resolve current slugs from the live sitemap before scheduling.

candidates.why_relevant: The chamber's banking/finance/insurance board is where cross-institution positions on draft financial legislation are formed; its published composition (president reported as Miloš Miketić, secretary Almer Bećiragić) is also a named-contact map into the institutions. Board members are elected for four-year terms, so the page doubles as a membership pointer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve the current slug from komora.me sitemap (the indexed URL returned 404 on fetch — likely a CMS slug change, not removal), then monitor board-session announcements.

candidates.source_name: Unija poslodavaca Crne Gore / Montenegrin Employers Federation (UPCG/MEF)
candidates.why_relevant: Representative umbrella employers' organisation and official social partner (National Tripartite Agreement, 2006; BusinessEurope member). It publishes formal objections to draft laws with fiscal/financial impact — e.g. it called for the Draft Law on Solidarity Contribution to be withdrawn from public discussion and challenged the Law on Internal Trade amendments on constitutional grounds. Useful as an early, blunt signal on tax/levy measures that hit banks and merchants.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl news/saopštenja stream in sr plus the /en/ mirror; keyword-filter on 'nacrt zakona', 'javna rasprava', 'primjedbe'.
queries_used: Unija poslodavaca Crne Gore primjedbe nacrt zakona

candidates.source_name: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council (MFIC)
candidates.why_relevant: MFIC gathers leading foreign investors (established 2009), including the foreign-owned banks that dominate the Montenegrin market; its members' positions on regulatory and supervisory burden are aggregated and published, and its membership page is a pointer to foreign-capital financial institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual White Book PDF pull + news crawl; scrape member list as an actor pointer.
queries_used: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council MFIC Bijela knjiga preporuke finansijski sektor

candidates.source_name: MFIC White Book / Bijela knjiga (annual investment-climate recommendations)
candidates.why_relevant: The White Book is the flagship annual compilation of member recommendations on legislation and regulatory practice, typically with a financial-services chapter; it is the closest thing to a standing scorecard of unresolved regulatory grievances, with year-on-year status tracking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF download and section-level diff against the prior edition to detect resolved vs persistent issues.
queries_used: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council MFIC Bijela knjiga preporuke finansijski sektor

candidates.source_name: AmCham Montenegro
candidates.why_relevant: AmCham Montenegro runs policy committees and a Policy Manager who coordinates working groups producing position papers and policy recommendations; it participates in the 'Partnership for a Better Business Environment' dialogue with ministries — a structured channel through which financial-sector regulatory positions reach government.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Montenegrin fintech, payment-institution, e-money or leasing industry association was found despite targeted local-language searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches combining 'udruženje', 'fintech', 'platne institucije' and Montenegro returned only the banking association, the chamber's mixed banking/insurance board and insurance bodies. Non-bank payment providers appear to be represented, if at all, through UBCG's digitalisation/fintech committee or the chamber, not through a body of their own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For sector=payments this is a structural coverage hole: there is no association-level aggregator of PSP positions, so PSP views on regulation must be collected firm-by-firm or via UBCG committee output.

negative_findings.description: UBCG does not appear to publish its consultation responses / position papers in a dedicated, systematic section of its own website.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetching ubcg.info/blog/ showed institutional announcements (assembly, awards, workshops, Bankar issues) from Dec 2025 to Jun 2026 with no draft-law or formal consultation items; concrete UBCG positions (Draft Law on Bank Resolution comments; AML/CFT amendment support; banking-secrecy proposal) surfaced only through press reporting. No RSS feed was visible on the blog page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most valuable A3 content from this cell exists but is not primary-published, so collection must be triangulated via gov.me public-discussion reports and specialist press rather than via a single association feed.

negative_findings.description: Three komora.me URLs returned by search (the banking/finance/insurance association board page, the associations index, and the legislation page) each returned HTTP 404 when fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: https://komora.me/en/cem/udruzenje-bankarstva-i-drugih-finansijskih-organizacija-i-osiguranja, https://komora.me/en/cem/udruzenja-2 and https://komora.me/en/cem/zakonodavstvo all 404'd, while the komora.me homepage fetched normally. The pages are indexed with content, so this reads as CMS slug churn, not removal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The chamber's banking board is a core cell source; recorded as unverified/hypothesis rather than dead. Slugs must be re-resolved from the live sitemap before any scheduled collection is configured.

negative_findings.description: No public, machine-readable member directory was located for Privredna komora Crne Gore, AmCham Montenegro, MFIC or Unija poslodavaca within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only leadership/board-composition fragments were retrieved (PKCG board president and secretary names; MFIC and MEF descriptive membership claims). Full member lists were not confirmed on any of the four sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale leans on member directories as the cheapest pointer to the full actor population; only UBCG (11 banks) and the insurance bureau delivered that reliably.

negative_findings.description: Two competing accountancy/audit institutes exist (ISRCG at isrcg.org and IRRCG at irrcg.co.me), plus a separate internal-audit institute (IIRCG at iircg.co.me), with overlapping names and certifications.
negative_findings.result_summary: IIRCG advertises an 'Ovlašćeni računovođa' certificate despite being the internal-auditors institute, and ISRCG also covers internal auditors — the naming and remit overlap is genuine, not a search artefact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity resolution risk: a collector keyed on 'institut ... revizora Crne Gore' will conflate three distinct bodies and mis-attribute positions on audit/accounting rules.

coverage_gaps.description: No association representing non-bank payment service providers, e-money institutions, fintechs, leasing or microfinance companies was identified for Montenegro.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check the CBCG register of payment institutions and the CRPS registry for any collective body; failing that, treat UBCG's digitalisation/fintech committee and the chamber's finance board as the only proxies and scout PSPs individually in the firm-level cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Association consultation responses (primjedbe na nacrt zakona) are not systematically primary-published; only fragments reached via press were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the collection route around gov.me 'javna rasprava' notices and the subsequent 'izvještaj o javnoj raspravi', which enumerate submitting organisations, and pair with a bankar.me/mina.news keyword monitor as the fast channel.

coverage_gaps.description: komora.me association-board and legislation slugs could not be resolved live (404s on indexed URLs).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://komora.me/sitemap.xml (or the site's own search) to enumerate current /pkcg/ and /en/cem/ paths, then pin the banking-board and zakonodavstvo URLs before scheduling.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage was built with Montenegrin/Serbian (ijekavian) terms only; no check was made for Cyrillic-script or Albanian-language variants of association names.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run key queries in Cyrillic ('Удружење банака Црне Горе', 'Привредна комора Црне Горе') and in Albanian for northern-municipality business bodies, to confirm nothing is missed.

coverage_gaps.description: Consumer-protection associations, which routinely respond to banking and payments consultations elsewhere in the region, were not scouted in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'udruženje za zaštitu potrošača Crne Gore', 'CEZAP', and the NVOinfo directory under consumer categories; consumer bodies are association-class and belong to this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on UBCG, and feed availability was not established for komora.me, poslodavci.org, mfic.me or nbocg.me.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /feed, /rss.xml and sitemap lastmod on each association domain; where absent, configure HTML diffing on the news index pages.

brief: Montenegro's association layer for banking and payments is small and highly concentrated: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (ubcg.info) is the pivotal actor, with 11 member banks, 16 topic committees mapped closely onto A3 themes, EBF affiliation and a documented habit of filing comments on draft laws such as the Bank Resolution Law and AML/CFT amendments. Around it sit the statutory Privredna komora Crne Gore (whose banking/finance/insurance Association Board and legislation section are the chamber-side channel, though their slugs currently 404 and need re-resolution), the representative employers' federation UPCG/MEF, the foreign-investor council MFIC with its annual White Book, AmCham, the insurers' bureau NBOCG, and three overlapping accountancy/audit institutes (ISRCG, IRRCG, IIRCG) whose registries are the cheapest pointer to the assurance profession. The critical structural weakness is that these bodies rarely primary-publish their consultation responses: the reliable capture route is gov.me 'javna rasprava' notices and the resulting public-discussion reports, backstopped by keyword monitoring of bankar.me, mina.news and cdm.me. There is no dedicated fintech, PSP, e-money or leasing association in Montenegro, so payments-side industry positions must be reached through UBCG's digitalisation/fintech committee or scouted firm by firm.
